window_concepts.title: Proscenium
window_concepts.design_thesis: Chat is a center stage; history and artifacts are wings sliding on one continuous floor plane from stage left.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Single-axis stagecraft: wings slide and settle along the horizontal; the floor line is a fixed landmark; no fades for structure.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Left wing: transient peek overlays the stage edge, pinned full is a docked wing, pinned compact is a narrow cast list of glyph rows; archive lives behind a wing toggle.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: A set-piece wing between history and stage with arch header, status chip, pill tab switcher, and editor handoff.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Wings compress before the stage narrows; the stage keeps a declared 520 px floor and history falls back to the compact cast list.

window_concepts.title: Bindery
window_concepts.design_thesis: The workspace is a bound working document: chat is the recto page under a running head, artifacts open as the facing verso page across a fixed gutter, history is a spine of thumb-tabs opening into a table of contents.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Fold-and-settle: leaves lay flat from a slight horizontal compression like paper settling; the gutter never moves.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Spine thumb-tabs always show open threads; peek and pinned full open a contents leaf with dot leaders; pinned compact keeps only the spine.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: A facing verso page with folio label, plate-numbered switcher, and gutter shadow separating it from the chat page.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The contents leaf yields first, then the verso page narrows to its clamp; the recto page holds the reading measure.

window_concepts.title: Instrument Deck
window_concepts.design_thesis: A slim instrument band above a calm transcript: route, mode, access, BSD, and context are labeled instrument cells; glance up for state, read down for conversation.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Mechanical precision: stepped easing, short indexed movements, split-flap value changes; nothing drifts.
window_concepts.history_strategy: A vertical film-strip of thread frames with sprocket-hole margins; compact keeps glyph frames; peek overlays the bay.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: An auxiliary monitor with bezel, AUX badge, status lamp, and numbered channel buttons for switching artifacts.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Instrument labels drop first, then the strip steps down to compact; the bay floor protects the transcript.

window_concepts.title: Depth Field
window_concepts.design_thesis: A shallow depth field: chat holds the front plane while history and artifacts rest on rear planes whose edges stay visible in a rim stack; pinning advances a plane until it docks flush.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Advance and recede along an implied z-axis with precomputed scale and elevation shadows; a surface always comes forward out of the visible stack and returns to it.
window_concepts.history_strategy: A card plane: peek floats it forward as an elevated panel, pinned full docks it flush, compact narrows it to glyph cards; the rim edge always shows where it lives.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: An artifact plane that advances from the rim with a stack switcher at its foot; closing recedes it into the rim.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Planes recede to the rim under pressure; the front plane keeps the floor; Glass themes carry the plate sheens.

window_concepts.title: Workbench
window_concepts.design_thesis: The artifact workspace is a co-equal bench to the left of Chat with its own tab rail and status shelf; chat defends a declared reading floor; history is a tool drawer.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Sturdy and utilitarian: quick short snaps with square timing; a drawer thunks open, a tab seats itself; no float, no drift.
window_concepts.history_strategy: A drawer with a visible handle: peek slides it over the bench, pinned full gives it a fixed slat, compact keeps a glyph rail.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: Bench tabs across the top, work surface in the middle, status shelf with path, state, and editor handoff below.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: The drawer degrades to compact first, then the bench narrows to its clamp; chat never dips under its floor.

window_concepts.title: Reading Room
window_concepts.design_thesis: Typographic calm: chrome recedes to hairline rules and small caps; history is a margin-note column of italic annotations; artifacts open on a reference desk with an inset paper surface.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Ink settling: a barely-there rise and opacity bloom, as ink takes to paper; nothing slides across the room.
window_concepts.history_strategy: Margin notes: two-line italic entries with state and age; compact reduces to margin marks; peek floats a note card.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: A reference desk with an eyebrow label, paper surface, and an underlined shelf of related references.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Margins fold away first; the room keeps its measure; the runner header thins but never disappears.

window_concepts.title: Mosaic
window_concepts.design_thesis: The workspace is a board of dockable tiles with visible handles and a shared gap rhythm; pinning history is docking its tile; a closed tile files into the tray at the bottom edge.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Reflow choreography: tiles grow and shrink along flex tracks; the tray chip is the tile's continuation, entering with the same movement that filed it.
window_concepts.history_strategy: A thread tile that docks (full), narrows (compact), lifts (peek), or files to a tray chip (closed) — geometry, never just an icon.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: An artifact tile with handle, status lamp, and footer chips for switching; closing files it to the tray beside the thread chip.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: Tiles yield in order (history, then artifact width) with the chat tile keeping its floor; the tray absorbs what the board cannot hold.

window_concepts.title: Periscope
window_concepts.design_thesis: Overlay-first adaptive shell: a left dock of circular lenses raises history and artifacts as overlays at narrow widths; past the crystallization threshold the same surfaces dock into real side geometry, stems tying them to their lenses.
window_concepts.motion_thesis: Lens morphs: surfaces scale out of their lens origin and collapse back into it; the lens is always origin and home.
window_concepts.history_strategy: One surface, two forms: overlay panel below 980 px observed width, docked column above it; pinned compact narrows the docked form; the lens shows raised state.
window_concepts.artifact_strategy: The artifact lens raises a surface with status, editor handoff, and circular per-artifact foot lenses.
window_concepts.narrow_width_strategy: This is the thesis: narrow is the native form; overlays never push the transcript, and docked geometry only exists when the workspace can afford it.

thread_concepts.title: Screenplay
thread_concepts.design_thesis: A bubble-less typographic script: speakers live in a small-caps margin, prose owns the measure, and system work reads as bracketed stage directions.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Print-like restraint: messages rise a few pixels and settle; stage-direction text replaces in place; nothing slides sideways.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: An inline form scene with lettered options, progress dots, skip/back/cancel in the script voice, and a stable outer footprint while question content replaces inside.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: One live stage direction updates in place; scene blocks (Goal, Tasks, Agents, Diffs) are ruled sections that collapse independently; completed work condenses to a single bracketed direction that reopens into a detail sheet.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Margin speaker labels keep the eye on one prose column at a 68ch measure; hover reveals times and the action row; at narrow widths the margin folds above the prose.

thread_concepts.title: Courier
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Messages are deliveries with spatial lineage — a sent message physically leaves the composer and travels into its durable slot; live work is one evolving locus pill.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Carriage: one vertical travel axis, FLIP from composer to slot; the locus pill never moves, only transforms; the questionnaire pill morphs into its card and back.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: The preparing pill expands into a card in the same spot above the composer, advances with a segment trail, and shrinks back into a submitting pill (video 4 lifecycle).
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: A locus pill carries the working summary and timer; the delivery manifest condenses Goal, tasks, agents, and diffs into one expandable strip; completed work becomes the reply's tools seam.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Classic asymmetric bubbles with hover stamps and quiet sibling action rows; deliveries cap at 78% width to keep a readable measure.

thread_concepts.title: Ledgerline
thread_concepts.design_thesis: The conversation is a ruled ledger: every message is an entry on its own rule with a structural time gutter; work posts as indented lines and reconciles into one balanced summary.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Entries unfold from their rule with a vertical unfurl; postings tick in one by one; a writing caret marks the active line.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: A form ledger — numbered question lines with a right answer column filled in place; navigation moves the active line; submit posts the answers.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Open postings: turn, goal, tasks, agents, and edits are typed ledger lines with values; completion reconciles them under a double rule that reopens on demand.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Full-width ruled entries with a fixed 70ch measure and small-caps parties; the gutter carries times so the prose column stays clean.

thread_concepts.title: Dossier
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Work files itself: messages are folder cards with corner tabs; all live work collects into one tabbed case file with a stable footprint; questions are paged forms with a review page.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Filing: cards slide into the stack, tabs switch content inside a fixed frame, submission stamps the file shut.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: Numbered page tabs plus an explicit Review page summarizing every answer before submit; skipped pages are marked and reversible (video 2 extended).
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: The case file: one card, tabs for Goal / Tasks / Agents / Changes, each a full projection with controls; completed work becomes a filed record inside the message card.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Paper cards with role tabs keep each message self-contained; user cards mirror right; metadata hides in the tab row until hover.

thread_concepts.title: Longhand
thread_concepts.design_thesis: One continuous manuscript: voices alternate as indented prose separated by asterisms; system events are centered typographic rules; questions arrive as an interview set into the page.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Handwriting pace: the page lengthens, rules draw themselves in, and nothing moves laterally; the live rule breathes only while work runs.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: An inline interview: italic prompts answered by em-dash options or a ruled freeform line; pass over, reconsider, abandon, and set-the-answers all speak the manuscript's language.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: Work is written into the record: a live running rule carries the current action; goal, tasks, hands, and edits set as prose paragraphs with superscript task states; records condense to centered rules.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: A 66ch centered column, serif-adjacent rhythm, your words in italic accent ink; the most reading-first of the eight.

thread_concepts.title: Counterweight
thread_concepts.design_thesis: Asymmetric balance: compact right-anchored counters for you, a full-measure editorial column for the assistant, numbered footnotes for metadata, and a counterweight work column opposite the text.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Balance shifts: weights drop into the pan and the beam returns to level on completion; everything else stays put.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: A ballot: roman-numeral options in full-measure typographic rows; abstain instead of skip, withdraw instead of cancel, cast instead of submit.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: The counterweight pan on the right rail: goal weight, task bars, agent lines, diff weights; each weight is compact and expandable; completion empties the pan into a footnote.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Editorial hierarchy — the assistant's column reads like an article at 70ch with footnote references; your counters stay scannable at a glance.

thread_concepts.title: Teletype
thread_concepts.design_thesis: A wire feed on a monospaced grid: transmission headers announce party and time; all system work shares one status line that rewrites itself in place; completed work rolls up into numbered wire summaries.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Carriage returns: stepped feeds, hard-cut status swaps, and a cursor block as the only continuous motion — and only while receiving.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: A boxed form printed field by field with numbered key hints, checkbox marks, and bracket-key navigation; the wire announces FORM INCOMING and TRANSMITTING.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: One status band above the composer compresses goal, tasks, hands, and edits into a single line that opens into a typed panel; no stacking, ever.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Dashed transmission rules and mono measure make scanning fast; long transmissions fold with a character count.

thread_concepts.title: Choreograph
thread_concepts.design_thesis: The transcript is a stage with authored entrances: messages arrive on an arc with anticipation and settle; the active turn wears an orbiting satellite that docks into the finished message as its worked badge.
thread_concepts.motion_thesis: Arcs with anticipation and settle; the satellite's orbit is the single continuous motion and only while work truly runs; reduced motion swaps it for a solid ring.
thread_concepts.question_strategy: A dealt hand: cards deal in from the bottom edge, answered cards tuck into a stack chip, and the stack fans back open for review before submitting.
thread_concepts.activity_strategy: The troupe: dancers (subagents) as status discs with names, steps (tasks) as a bar row, the goal as a badge line; the orbit frame carries the live summary and docks on completion.
thread_concepts.conversation_reading_strategy: Soft cards with staggered entrances; the drama lives in transitions while resting states stay calm for long reading.
